<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a Diels-Alder retro template. The forward reaction forms two C–C sigma bonds (bond type 6-6) and changes two C=C double bonds to single bonds, so we look for templates with bonds_formed ["6-6"] and bonds_order_changed ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"]. Limit results to a few entries.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
